independentReview.method: Ran SCRIPTA_CDP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9235 node tools/shf/qa-film.mjs presentations/two-ways-to-build-a-world (valid, 23/23 checks, 51 sampled frames, 0 JS errors). Inspected all qa/screenshots (first, sentence midpoints, last; Color/Paper/Night; phone-393/320) plus extra silent paused captures at 20% and 90% of every spoken sentence in all three themes at 1200 px, at 60% of every sentence at 393 px (Color, Paper) and 320 px (Night), and character crops for scene 2 across all themes. Player muted, paused, own tabs only, central Play overlay hidden for art captures; no audible playback.

minor: Scene 1 and scene 2: the dark/white disc on the pyramid apex (ruler/apex position) is unlabelled and not narrated; readable as an apex figure but slightly ambiguous.
Scene 1 sentence 1: Domination/Partnership name labels arrive only near the end of the sentence that names them; acceptable but slightly late.
Scene 2 sentence 1: the participant frowns (worried/skeptical) on a sentence planned as 'methodical'; reads as skepticism toward boxes, so not a contradiction.
Scene 2 sentences 3-4: the participant stays passive at the far left without gesture during 'grave' and 'reassuring' beats; only expression changes carry the emotion.
Scene 2 sentence 1: the ballot tick over the domination box extends beyond its checkbox frame.

Scene 3 sentence 1: Monitoring, Graduated sanctions and Appeal are a floating icon list beside the commons rather than acting on it; the bottom member pictogram touches the commons ellipse edge and sits just above a boundary post.
Scene 3 sentence 3: the open book uses a thick teal outline with slightly warped page edges rather than the shared book-art shape; recognizable but less refined than ART_DIRECTION recommends.
Phone widths (393/320): radar axis labels, conversion-loop labels, 'Technology and institutions' and limit checklist text render around 8 px; legible only up close.

independentReview.notes: Meaning sequence verified: golden age fades out during 'drops the peaceful golden age'; recurring-period timeline fills during sentence 3; coin stacks swap after technology and institutions appear; conversion loop closes and the Leave axis is struck through with a collapsed profile by the end of 'until escape disappears'; limits check off and exit door opens before the profile is restored; AI paths split to empire machine and partnership lattice; Chapter 3 page and reader map appear in the final invitation. Character identity (person with teal coat, yellow scarf) stable across all frames and themes; no ghost or duplicated limbs, no props over faces, no caption collisions, flat backgrounds in all themes.
